region:calabarzon.note: The bars show how much each of five factor groups (Market / Prices, Climate Stress, Fish Kill, Employment and OFW Remittance) contributed to this forecast. The five shares add up to 100 percent. A long bar does not by itself mean that a factor raised the risk: the colour of each bar shows whether that factor raised or lowered the forecast. In the current model only Market / Prices (provincial food and rice price movements) is an input; Climate Stress, Fish Kill, Employment and OFW Remittance have no input in it, so they show 0 percent, and the news reports linked to them are listed separately. Part of the forecast also depends on the regional hunger survey, the latest published risk level and the overall volume of news; that part is not shown in the five groups. These figures are model estimates, not official government statistics.
